samples.xml_description:
<module id="accu">
    <description>Accumulator module that accumulates 4 input 8-bit data values and outputs their sum.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data for addition.</input>
        <input id="valid_in">Input signal indicating readiness for new data.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Output signal indicating when 4 input data accumulation is reached.</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">10-bit output data representing the accumulated sum.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter>STATE_IDLE</parameter>
        <parameter>STATE_ACCUMULATE</parameter>
        <parameter>THRESHOLD</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="count" width="2">Count of valid inputs received.</reg>
        <reg id="accumulated_sum" width="10">Sum of accumulated data.</reg>
        <reg id="current_state" width="2">Current state of the accumulator.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                count <= 2'b00;
                accumulated_sum <= 10'b0000000000;
                current_state <= STATE_IDLE;
                valid_out <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case (current_state)
                    STATE_IDLE: begin
                        if (valid_in) begin
                            count <= 2'b001;
                            accumulated_sum <= data_in;
                            current_state <= STATE_ACCUMULATE;
                        end
                    end
                    STATE_ACCUMULATE: begin
                        if (valid_in && count < THRESHOLD) begin
                            count <= count + 2'b01;
                            accumulated_sum <= accumulated_sum + data_in;
                        end else if (count == THRESHOLD) begin
                            valid_out <= 1'b1;
                            current_state <= STATE_IDLE;
                        end
                    end
                    default: begin
                        current_state <= STATE_IDLE;
                        valid_out <= 1'b0;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
